# Orrery Method

> A way of running a software project where the work is done by AI agents, and one person directs, judges, and decides.

Version 0.0.4 · MIT · https://github.com/nyxene/orrery-method

## Docs

- [The whole methodology as one markdown document](method.md)
- [Overview](en/overview.html): what is scarce, and what follows from it
- [Roles](en/roles.html): three accountabilities, four stations, and the one human at the top
- [Artifacts](en/artifacts.html): the four things that exist
- [The cycle](en/cycle.html): six stages, and what each one hands to the next
- [Invariants](en/invariants.html): the eight properties that always hold, and the tooling that checks them
- [Terms](en/terms.html): the vocabulary, fixed in English for every locale
- [Classification](en/classification.html): the four axes, and where every kind of work is routed
- [Measurement](en/measurement.html): the ledger, the cost model, and what a forecast is worth
- [Automation](en/automation.html): what is enforced, what is derived, and what must never be built
- [Mapping](en/mapping.html): two bindings in full, four more as their differences
- [Playbooks](en/playbooks.html): the method walked end to end
- [Agents](en/agents.html): one way to staff the accountabilities and stations — the one this method grew up under
- [Application](en/application.html): how a project takes the method up, and one tool that follows it
